en-US.longDescription: Usually, we hate it when pictures turn out blurry – and any photo editor can fix that – but it takes a dedicated tool to make blurred images ADD to the quality of an image. Movavi Photo Focus lets you use photo blur as a creative way to tell amazing visual stories!
en-US.name: Movavi Photo Focus

zh-CN.longDescription: 通常，我们都会讨厌照片拍得模糊——而任何照片编辑软件都可以修复这一点——但要让模糊图像为图片质量增色，就需要使用专门的工具了。Movavi Photo Focus 让您能够以创意的方式运用照片虚化效果，讲述令人惊叹的视觉故事！
